Factorization is onto im(p); extension to unused codomain values may need extra assumptions.
limitations: Does not imply preservation of additional graph/order structure.
Qualitative failure is not a canonical numerical mass or measured detector completeness.
CHECK-021 exhausts only 64 map pairs on a three-element carrier; the general argument is mathematical fibre factorization, not a runtime replay.

findings.title: Live categorical templates conflate different mathematical structures
findings.finding: The live 2-morphism template calls an ordered sequence of skills a natural transformation eta:f=>g, without parallel functors, components or naturality. The capability template calls colour/license lists a suboperad and evaluation algebra without units/closure or actions. These are useful routing declarations but do not establish the named mathematical structures.
findings.recommended_action: Label the legacy category templates as illustrative or retired and require explicit law-bearing owners before asserting categorical semantics. Keep syntactic signature checks distinct from mathematical construction.
findings.validation: Full source reading; definitional mismatch, not a runtime replay.

findings.title: Approval example admits an explicit negative decision
findings.finding: The unanchored grep for APPROVED also accepts NOT APPROVED and UNAPPROVED, so the shown gate does not enforce the claimed approval state or bind it to the current revision.
findings.recommended_action: Read an exact typed decision field bound to the reviewed revision; reject missing/ambiguous state.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-002 independently confirms the literal match. Git Bash could not initialize, so no actual grep execution is claimed.

findings.title: Broken-link failures do not reach the compliance script exit flag
findings.finding: scan_links pipes output into a while loop whose bad() call changes fail in a pipeline subshell. Under normal Bash/POSIX pipeline execution, a link-only failure leaves outer fail=0 and the final script can print PASS and exit zero.
findings.recommended_action: Run the loop in the parent shell or explicitly propagate its status; add an otherwise-valid broken-link negative fixture and assert nonzero exit.
findings.validation: Source-level control-flow finding. OPSKILL-CHECK-001 was NOT RUN: MSYS failed before the minimal isolated fragment with NtCreateDirectoryObject access denied; failed attempt retained.

findings.title: Overflow sentinel is not refused by every finite ceiling
findings.finding: The test-quality law states checked multiplication with u64::MAX fallback refuses every finite ceiling. u64::MAX is finite and a cost<=ceiling gate at that maximum admits the sentinel.
findings.recommended_action: Return a typed overflow refusal or explicitly exclude the sentinel from valid costs/ceilings and test the boundary.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-003 gives the exact finite counterexample; no claim about an uninspected runtime budget owner.

findings.title: Uncertainty is incorrectly turned into refutation
findings.finding: The adversarial receipt-audit rule defaults to REFUTED when uncertain. A finding not yet supported or independently decidable is UNKNOWN/UNCONFIRMED; uncertainty supplies no counterexample or refutation.
findings.recommended_action: Use an explicit unresolved status and reserve REFUTED for a bound contradictory witness or deciding argument.
findings.validation: Direct full-body semantic review; no external source needed.

findings.title: Hermetic verification example does not compute the candidate hash
findings.finding: The command labelled verify candidate hash imports hashlib but only compares receipt fields against supplied literals. It never reads candidate bytes or test output; the companion grep cannot establish absence of cross-task evidence borrowing.
findings.recommended_action: Provide an actual candidate-manifest rehasher and structured local execution receipt validation; label the two comparisons as partial illustration until implemented.
findings.validation: Full command-body inspection only; no retained command executed.

findings.title: Status wording is internally inconsistent across admission surfaces
findings.finding: Scientific-pattern memo says IMPLEMENTED/live at the top but ends draft/not admitted with an empty sign-off. Three generated lessons say admitted by host replay yet their source admission is Unadmitted. These distinct statuses need explicit object/edition labels.
findings.recommended_action: Name exactly what was implemented, reviewed, historically replayed and separately admitted; preserve historical claims without presenting conflicting current status.
findings.validation: Full-body comparison; does not infer missing historical authorizations.

findings.title: Digestion cleanup instruction omits the linked authorization condition
findings.finding: The main digestion skill mandates removing every completed active source, while its linked pattern allows optional cleanup only when authorized and exact custody/resolution survives. Completion of analysis alone does not make source deletion necessary or safe.
findings.recommended_action: Make the main finish step explicitly inherit the optional authorization and custody conditions; retain no-change and unresolved cases.
findings.validation: Instruction consistency review only; no source removed or moved.

findings.title: Repeated held-out merge feedback needs a narrower validation claim
findings.finding: The hypothesis-tree specification calls the held-out evaluator never used for branch selection, but uses its score to decide each merge and propagates insights into subsequent trials. Repeated visible gate feedback can influence search even when only dev scores rank branches.
findings.recommended_action: Track held-out query budget and adaptive reuse, restrict feedback, or reserve a fresh final holdout; describe the merge gate as finite nonregression evidence unless a generalization argument is provided.
findings.validation: Procedure-level information-flow analysis, not evidence that a particular experiment leaked.

findings.title: Reframing does not guarantee zero obstruction
findings.finding: The dialectical guide depicts gauge break and dimensional expansion ending at zero defect and proposes a higher-dimensional quotient where obstruction retracts to zero. Coordinate changes and embeddings alone need not remove a nonzero class; a collapsing quotient can erase the protected task instead.
findings.recommended_action: Require explicit source/target carriers, admissible repair or transport map, answer preservation and a deciding certificate; label the diagram as a proposed search rather than guaranteed descent.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-012 keeps defect 1 under x->-x and x->(x,0) with zero repair image.

findings.title: Persona removal and examiner placement overstate invariance and independence
findings.finding: The architecture claims removing all persona overlays leaves all packets and receipts byte-identical, while FindingV1 carries persona_id and profiles contain generation strategy fields. It also claims an external examiner guarantees absolute epistemic independence. Neither assertion follows from this schema or routing separation.
findings.recommended_action: Specify the exact persona-free projection and test its invariance; distinguish worker/process independence, shared model/source dependence and empirical error independence.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-013 illustrates byte change when the declared persona field is removed; no actual runtime ablation or independence experiment performed.

findings.title: Routing terminals overlap and majority share is not capture evidence
findings.finding: DIVERSE permits every share <=50%, while CONCENTRATED also permits 35--50%; a 40% queue meets both. The ratio is undefined on an empty queue, and a legitimately specialized workload may route mostly to one qualified owner without cognitive capture.
findings.recommended_action: Define an empty-population status and disjoint ordered criteria; retain concentration as a diagnostic conditioned on task mix and eligible destinations.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-011 uses counts [2,2,1] and exact share 2/5.

findings.title: Anti-pattern linter can return green without auditing requested evidence
findings.finding: Although audit_catalog emits CATALOG_MISSING, main calls it only if the directory already exists. Missing requested paths are ignored; failed Git discovery and file reads return empty findings. --check then returns 0 when the accumulated count is zero, including unavailable or wholly unobserved inputs.
findings.recommended_action: Treat requested missing/unreadable inputs and discovery failure as explicit unavailable/refused results; enforce a declared nonempty eligible population and distinguish zero findings from successful observation.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-008 reproduces the minimal missing-catalog branch. Retained script not executed.

findings.title: Healthy-pattern certification has no implemented certifier
findings.finding: The hunter advertises universal annihilation, an adjunction and certification of healthy-pattern adherence. Its implementation only emits a few anti-pattern token/regex matches; healthy_certifications is initialized empty and never populated. PASS means no such signatures were found, even on no files.
findings.recommended_action: Rename outcomes to scoped signature scan results, report missing/unsupported inputs, and either implement separately specified healthy predicates with negative controls or remove certification language.
findings.validation: Full source review plus OPSKILL-CHECK-014 shows the stated types do not imply A(H(c))=0. No production scanner execution.

findings.title: Rust Ord heuristic misses PartialOrd-only derives and migrated paths
findings.finding: Both scanners require crates_rs in the path and search for Ord as a substring in preceding lines. PartialOrd therefore suppresses the missing-Ord finding, and code/rust paths do not enter the check at all. The blanket message that lacking Ord causes nondeterministic collections also exceeds the checked property.
findings.recommended_action: Parse derive names exactly, scope to declared ordering-dependent key types and current source roots, then add PartialOrd-only and nonordering benign controls.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-009 evaluates both exact string predicates without compiling Rust.

findings.title: Output fence validates an argument the delegated parser need not use
findings.finding: auto_anti_skill validates only the first separate --output argument, discards the returned normalized path and forwards unchanged sys.argv to the legacy CLI. Duplicate options or differing relative-path resolution can cause delegated output selection to disagree with the checked destination.
findings.recommended_action: Parse once, reject duplicate/unknown output forms, pass the validated absolute destination to the delegated API and verify original path components before mutation.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-010 demonstrates first-versus-last --output selection with ordinary argparse. Actual legacy CLI was not executed; exploitability depends on its parser and availability.

findings.title: Mathematical validity is not a source recovery mechanism
findings.finding: The scene maxim says true code can always be reconstructed after reorganizations or migrations. Mathematical truth does not retain a particular proof/program encoding, dependencies, build environment or evidence bytes. This claim can undermine the otherwise explicit immutable-custody requirements.
findings.recommended_action: State that validity can survive an explicitly verified semantics-preserving transport while recoverability requires retained exact bytes and dependencies.
findings.validation: Source-level scope distinction; no recovery operation attempted.

findings.title: Session provenance guarantee exceeds Git status observations
findings.finding: The documentation protocol promises every session-created or modified file, but discovers from current git status and filters directories; the main skill also caps displayed paths at 100. Current status can contain pre-existing edits and omit session changes already committed or reverted.
findings.recommended_action: Describe touched-path discovery as a bounded current working-tree observation, or bind a start snapshot and explicit session change/event ledger with disclosed exclusions.
findings.validation: Declared discovery contract comparison only; delegated auto-docs service not executed.

findings.title: Check and inspect modes still mutate files
findings.finding: auto_learn accepts positional action check or inspect, but never reads args.action. Every action reaches execute_auto_learn_repair and the file write unless --dry-run was separately supplied. A caller selecting inspect can therefore trigger modifications from discovered or supplied remediation records.
findings.recommended_action: Dispatch action explicitly; make check/inspect structurally read-only, including discovery outputs, and add a byte-preservation test for each mode.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-015 confirms zero args.action reads after full-body review. No retained repair command executed.

findings.title: Failed or unavailable repair verification becomes VERIFIED_CLEAN
findings.finding: Rollback requires both nonzero lint exit and parsed positive file-findings count. Missing checker, crash output, unparsed nonzero exit or an exception falls through; mypy return code is ignored unless stdout contains an error at a repaired line. The function then unconditionally labels the repair VERIFIED_CLEAN.
findings.recommended_action: Require every mandatory verifier to run and return a valid bound success receipt; preserve unavailable/error status and restore exact bytes on any required-check failure.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-016 demonstrates exit 2 plus no parsed count reaching VERIFIED_CLEAN in the isolated branch.

findings.title: Repair destination is not confined to the declared repository or selected paths
findings.finding: Supplied remediation file values are normalized by lstrip and joined/resolved without an is_relative_to check; Windows absolute paths override repo_root. A direct-path fallback widens this further. Substring-based --files filtering is not exact path authorization.
findings.recommended_action: Resolve and enforce an explicit owned-path allowlist, reject absolute/traversing and link-escaping inputs, and bind suggestions to exact current file hashes before any write.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-017 is a pure Windows path calculation selecting C:/outside/file.md; no external file touched.

findings.title: Repair rollback is lossy and unbound to current source bytes
findings.finding: Repair reads with errors=replace, uses text snapshots, ignores supplied matched_snippet/source identity and performs unguarded write_text. Invalid UTF-8 cannot be restored byte-for-byte, newline conventions can change, and intervening edits can be overwritten. Fixed discovery receipt paths may also supply stale suggestions after failed subprocesses.
findings.recommended_action: Snapshot exact bytes, require strict decoding and current digest/snippet agreement, use unique bound discovery receipts and atomic compare-and-swap writes/rollback.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-018 proves replacement-decoded bytes do not round-trip. No concurrent or filesystem mutation probe was run.

findings.title: Markdown marker repair consumes an empty bullet line ending
findings.finding: The repair regex uses whitespace classes that include newline. For an empty bullet line "* \n", replacement yields "- " with no line ending; joining the lines can absorb the next line into the bullet despite the claimed minimal character change. Direct suggestions also do not revalidate code-fence context.
findings.recommended_action: Restrict marker spacing to horizontal whitespace, preserve exact line terminators and revalidate Markdown context and current matched bytes.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-019 independently evaluates the exact regex on the bounded empty-bullet input.

findings.title: Obstruction scanners label lexical graph diagnostics as mathematical exactness
findings.finding: The AST wrapper defines phi_1/gamma_2 as weighted counts of named import defects and sets is_exact/is_closed from zero counts; it supplies no cochain, differentials or exactness certificate. The ten-level companion checks filenames, heading presence and path/count existence, omitting promised semantic levels and most claimed invariants.
findings.recommended_action: Use diagnostic names tied to the actual finite predicates, report unread/missing populations, and bind any cohomological interpretation to explicit carriers/maps/theorems rather than labels.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-020 separates directed acyclicity from nonzero H1 of a triangular one-skeleton. No imported AST owner, Lean or native checker executed.

findings.title: Read-only AutoP handoff writes a report but declares no files written
findings.finding: Default/post-run calls run_anti_pattern_lint_on_changed, creates a report directory and passes --report-out to a writer. The returned handoff still says files_written=[] and the CLI advertises without writing files. Fixed report names also permit stale reports to be consumed after subprocess failure.
findings.recommended_action: Make the handoff genuinely in-memory or explicitly disclose every durable output; use unique current-run receipt identities and require successful bound readback before consuming suggestions.
findings.validation: Complete control-flow review of runner and already-read lint writer; neither retained script executed.

findings.title: Missing maintenance gates and catalog errors can retain PASS
findings.finding: Parity, budget, census and eval stages initialize PASS and only warn when their required script is absent. The catalog-failure branch checks skill_id==anti-pattern-lint, but the actual discovered package is auto-anti-pattern-lint; its nonzero exit is downgraded to a warning. Stage-1 anti-skill hits append errors without reliably setting FAIL. Overall status inspects only status fields.
findings.recommended_action: Declare required/optional applicability before execution; use BLOCKED/FAIL for unavailable required checks, match canonical IDs and derive stage outcome from all mandatory results.
findings.validation: Source-level path and branch analysis, not a maintenance run.

findings.title: Maintenance continues to mutation stages after gate failure
findings.finding: run_autop calls every stage unconditionally, including governance apply, and computes overall FAIL only afterward. Thus a failed budget/parity/evaluation gate does not prevent later archival/digestion/application activity despite gate terminology.
findings.recommended_action: Separate read-only diagnostic collection from authorized mutations and require all applicable prerequisite gates to pass before each mutation. Retain failures without advancing the guarded action.
findings.validation: Full orchestration-body review; imported mutation services were not executed or credited as reviewed.

findings.title: Episode mining substitutes fabricated dialogue and default fixture episodes
findings.finding: When review errors exist, Stage 1 constructs Auditor/Assistant dialogue including an acknowledgment never observed in the input. Even after segmenting that transcript, mine-candidates prefers default_episodes.json whenever present, rather than the current segmentation. A successful mining command therefore need not learn from the current reviewed run.
findings.recommended_action: Label synthetic fixtures explicitly and keep them outside observed-run learning; bind mining inputs to current actual observations or report fixture-only output.
findings.validation: Source data-flow review; no segmentation/mining/provider call or fixture read.

findings.title: Signal heuristics substitute repetition and syntax for substantive validation
findings.finding: The signal table says ten identical template instantiations validate the template, min-size checks replace per-agent review, and calculate_X() distinguishes computed from fitted values. Repeated output and an executable function may reproduce the same invalid rule or fitted constant; these checks cannot establish semantic correctness or parameter provenance.
findings.recommended_action: Treat these as candidate-discovery/packaging signals only; preserve source-aware review and trace every fitted/imported parameter.
findings.validation: Full source-body review; retained workflow not executed.

findings.title: Skill lifecycle stages are not the asserted cochain quotient
findings.finding: Raw Idea, Draft SKILL.md and Cross-Host Sync are named as C0,C1,C2 with d0,d1, then C1/im(d0) is called novel capability. No additive carriers, linear maps, zero composition or equivalence relation for that quotient is defined. Ordinary drafting followed by synchronization is generally nonzero, so sequential lifecycle arrows do not construct a cochain complex.
findings.recommended_action: Use a state-transition workflow description, or supply precise algebraic carriers/maps and prove d1*d0=0 before claiming a cochain quotient.
findings.validation: Full source-body review; retained workflow not executed.

findings.title: Positive-optimum dual rule uses the wrong primal objective
findings.finding: The claimed precise LP rule requires <w,omega>=||omega||1, whereas minimizing ||omega-d0 alpha||1 requires equality with the supplied feasible residual norm. For omega=(1,1), d0 alpha=(alpha,0), alpha=1 and w=(0,1), optimum and dual value are 1 while the skill requires 2. It also never binds alpha through the stated equality.
findings.recommended_action: Bind primal feasibility, residual r=omega-d0 alpha, dual feasibility and equality <w,omega>=||r||1; evaluate w in the subgradient at r.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-022 is an exact two-coordinate counterexample; no reviewer runtime run.

findings.title: Prerequisite gate labels path existence RAN and accepts directories as programs
findings.finding: The fixed table contains scripts, data and one directory without declared entry types. Any target directory receives RAN with null digest, including a directory occupying a required .py path. No interpreter, import or executable check occurs. This contradicts the advertised resolution of every mandatory script/interpreter and makes RAN misleading.
findings.recommended_action: Type each prerequisite; require regular files for scripts, hash directories through a manifest and use PRESENT/RESOLVED rather than RAN. Keep availability separate from execution.
findings.validation: Full source-body review; retained workflow not executed.

findings.title: Incomparable mirror declarations evade completeness refusal
findings.finding: check_mirror_set refuses only named < actual_set. A declaration naming an obsolete extra host while omitting a real host is incomparable, so it passes despite missing required hosts. The same file correctly uses ungranted-set difference for agent licences, showing the intended safer pattern.
findings.recommended_action: Test actual_set-named for missing hosts and handle extras explicitly; prefer structured host declarations to prose/token heuristics.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-023: {.agents,.grok} versus {.agents,.claude} evades strict-subset refusal.

findings.title: Agent capability audit ignores absent licence text and undeclared deployed agents
findings.finding: Licence parity skips comparisons if either parser returns None, scans only canonical agent names, and filters out hosts whose agents directory is absent. Removing a licence or adding a new deployed-only agent therefore escapes the advertised authority comparison. Fully absent deployed directories become VACUOUS, and the main receipt still becomes PASS if nothing is BLOCKED.
findings.recommended_action: Require an explicit valid licence per applicable agent, compare union inventories, and make missing expected deployments a refusal. Expose NOT_APPLICABLE/VACUOUS distinctly in aggregate status.
findings.validation: Source control-flow review; tests cover existing empty deployed directories but not missing licence or extra agent.

findings.title: Cross-host hashing normalizes binary bytes and can miss corruption
findings.finding: The tree walker applies CRLF-to-LF replacement to every non-cache file, regardless of type, before hashing. Distinct binary artifacts can compare equal. This is broader than the source guidance to normalize text while preserving binary bytes and cannot support byte-identical custody.
findings.recommended_action: Compare raw hashes for custody and binaries; if text equivalence is desired, declare encoding/type and record both raw and normalized digests.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-024 preserves a distinct synthetic binary pair with identical normalized hash input.

findings.title: Hill threshold does not guarantee distributed reinforcement
findings.finding: A sum of signals followed by a Hill curve is not inherently a multisensor quorum. The declared parameters allow K=1/2,n=2,tau=1/2, for which one signal 1 gives H=4/5 and activates. Duplicate or correlated reports are also unconstrained; n and K have no positivity/finite guard. The final nonclaim still asserts distributed reinforcement and the reference calls it noise immunity.
findings.recommended_action: Require authenticated distinct sensors, state dependence assumptions, constrain K,n,tau and prove the single-sensor upper bound falls below threshold; keep the result a score policy.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-025 is exact rational arithmetic for one admitted signal.

findings.title: Danger-gate description and residual diagnostic disagree with the stated predicate
findings.finding: The description requires both signals before acting, but Signal 2 alone produces DEFENSIVE_LOCKDOWN. The reference equates positive Phi/Gamma with non-descent, although a residual decreasing from 10 to 1 is still positive. These are materially different triggers.
findings.recommended_action: State the actual Boolean policy and define before/after comparable residuals; distinguish positive defect from failure of descent.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-028 demonstrates positivity with strict descent; no detector implementation run.

findings.title: Coarse unresolved fraction is not an upper bound after denominator restriction
findings.finding: The dossier proposal calls 273/280 unmatched refs an upper bound before restricting to catalog_bindings. Restricting both numerator and denominator can raise or lower the unresolved proportion; dropping seven resolved out-of-scope refs gives 273/273.
findings.recommended_action: Label the coarse percentage unscoped/unknown and recompute the exact declared population before claiming bounds.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-026 is subset arithmetic, not a replay of the actual dossier corpus.

findings.title: SVG sanitizer can silently convert intended text into elements
findings.finding: html.unescape decodes numeric references too; the mask protects only five named entities. Text <g/> becomes a g element while the document still parses, so mandatory XML parsing does not prevent this semantic change. Literal sentinel strings can also be substituted accidentally.
findings.recommended_action: Escape text at construction boundaries with a proper XML serializer; if converting named HTML entities, preserve numeric/XML escapes and avoid collision-prone sentinel substitution.
findings.validation: OPSKILL-CHECK-027 constructs two parseable SVGs with different text/element structure.

findings.title: Half-life model and deterministic deactivation implement different dynamics
findings.finding: The reference states exponential N(t)=N0 exp(-lambda t), but the protocol deactivates every unstimulated rule as soon as runs_idle reaches half_life_runs. A cohort vanishes at that cutoff rather than retaining half its initial population. The documents do not supply a randomized or weighted bridge.
findings.recommended_action: Name the implemented policy an idle timeout, or define decay weights/hazards and their half-life relationship; reevaluate mutations against clean and malicious controls.
findings.validation: Full source-body review; retained workflow not executed.

findings.title: Four-lock certification lacks the measurable carriers it claims to exhaust
findings.finding: Blackrod documents mathematical severity certification, intentional-malice identification and all-edge-case/topological certification, but give no metric definitions, finite carrier, exhaustive algorithm or operational enforcement binding. Role names, fictional keys and incident signatures cannot establish those properties.
findings.recommended_action: Keep these as governance workflow labels until each lock names inputs, implemented predicates, source pins, authority/authentication boundary and bounded failure controls.
findings.validation: Full source-body review; retained workflow not executed.

findings.title: Git safety hook is a fail-open lexical filter
findings.finding: The hook checks unanchored literal-like regexes after jq extraction without checking parse/tool failure. git -C repo push origin main evades every pattern; missing jq or malformed JSON can leave an empty command and exit 0. Quoted documentation can match despite no Git operation. The guide promises all push variants.
findings.recommended_action: Use validated structured inputs and a shell-aware command boundary; refuse parse/tool errors, explicitly cover global options and limit claims to supported syntax.
findings.validation: CHECK-030 is an in-memory regex counterexample; Git and Bash were not launched.

findings.title: Lock-file age/size and force teardown are insufficient preservation proofs
findings.finding: The recovery reference defines stale as zero bytes plus unchanged mtime over two checks, but a live Git operation may legitimately hold that same lock unchanged. Another recipe force-removes a worktree after inspecting only committed diff, which excludes untracked/unstaged work. These shortcuts conflict with the later clean-status preservation protocol.
findings.recommended_action: Require process/owner coordination and independently preserved recovery state; prefer refusal/non-forced removal when dirty or ownership is unknown. Do not infer liveness from mtime alone.
findings.validation: Full source-body review; no retained program or historical command executed.

findings.title: Selective-landing recipes confuse endpoint differences with merge deletion and supersession
findings.finding: A branch lacking a file added later on main yields ONLY_MAIN in a two-dot tree diff, but a three-way merge normally retains that file. Similarly, resolving every conflict to main before checking for an empty diff can erase genuine conflicting PR changes by construction. Comparing one commit touched paths cannot prove all earlier branch commits landed.
findings.recommended_action: Use pinned merge-base authored deltas and actual prospective merge trees; assess conflicting intent before choosing main, and enumerate every branch-only commit/path before declaring supersession.
findings.validation: Full source-body review; no retained program or historical command executed.

findings.title: Idempotence alone does not make residual norm the true L1 distance
findings.finding: The quotient skill states ||x-Cx||1 is the true L1 quotient distance for idempotent endomorphisms. C=[[1,2],[0,0]] is idempotent, but x=(0,1) gives residual norm 3 while its distance to im(C), the x-axis, is 1. The formula can define a projector-dependent diagnostic but not the claimed general minimum.
findings.recommended_action: State the quotient and norm precisely. Require a proven metric projection property or solve/certify the minimum independently; retain the residual as a separate diagnostic.
findings.validation: CHECK-031 verifies the exact matrix and distances.

findings.title: Static inward-dependency resolver drops imported submodule aliases
findings.finding: When ImportFrom.module is present, import_targets returns only the module name. Thus from pkg import infrastructure omits the outer-layer alias and passes, unlike import pkg.infrastructure. The top-level scanner also treats an empty discovered domain population as PASS and the single-root check only looks for applications.
findings.recommended_action: Resolve imported names against known module/package inventory, declare dynamic-import limits, require expected scan population and cover every declared layer root.
findings.validation: CHECK-032 reproduces the missing alias using Python AST only.

findings.title: Exact-solver documentation mixes missing evidence with obstruction and overstates attainment argument
findings.finding: The main skill maps missing problem data to OPEN_OBSTRUCTION, while its reference correctly says missing evidence must be UNAVAILABLE/refusal and positive obstruction needs a witness. The main skill also appeals to compactness/extreme vertices of unrestricted real potentials, but gauge translations make that domain noncompact and leave lineality unless quotient/gauge fixing is supplied.
findings.recommended_action: Use one typed unavailable terminal; separately state finite graph, positive weights, gauge fixing/quotient coercivity and rational inputs for the spanning-forest attainment argument. Do not present the hard-coded triangle script as a general solver test.
findings.validation: Full source-body review; no retained program or historical command executed.

findings.title: Finite algebra validator rubric incorrectly requires all categories and monoids to be groupoids
findings.finding: The relational reference groups categories, monoids and groupoids together and mandates inverse maps/laws for every morphism. General categories and monoids need not have inverses. Nonempty carrier is likewise an additional policy for categories, not a general categorical axiom.
findings.recommended_action: Split category/monoid/group/groupoid contracts and test the exact selected axioms; record nonemptiness as an explicit admission when required.
findings.validation: CHECK-036 checks a finite category A->B with identities and no inverse for its nonidentity arrow.

findings.title: Governance verification commands certify much less than their prose and PASS labels
findings.finding: Release checker searches one zero-hash string and never examines staging or recomputes digests; Lean checker only recognizes a toolchain prefix and never builds or inspects axioms; literature checker accepts any YAML mapping and never reconciles indices. Each is presented as verification of substantially broader invariants.

findings.validation: CHECK-033 and CHECK-034 show invalid toolchain suffix and undetected digest forms; source review shows no relevant execution paths.

findings.title: Unit-backed Lean structure destroys the promised representation opacity
findings.finding: The Lean skill suggests structure T where carrier : Unit := () as an opaque abstract carrier substitute. This constructs a concrete inhabited singleton, exposing its representation and collapsing all instances; it cannot represent an arbitrary Vector6 or preserve intended domain cardinality. Explicit domain-contract hypotheses do not undo that carrier restriction.

findings.title: Pedagogy discovery can omit malformed categorized tracks and assertion presence is weak
findings.finding: Categorized discovery occurs only if both notebooks and concepts directories exist. A numbered track with only concepts falls into legacy discovery, which only admits children already containing a matching notebook, so its missing companions can disappear from the census while other tracks keep strict nonzero count. Assertion detection also accepts assert 1 and unreachable assertions.
findings.recommended_action: Classify layout from an explicit declaration or any categorized marker, report missing required directories before fallback, and keep syntactic assertion counts distinct from executed mutation-sensitive checks.
findings.validation: CHECK-035 exercises the exact AST predicate on synthetic strings; discovery omission established by complete branch review.

findings.title: Governance contracts retain conflicting live output, host and publication policies
findings.finding: Git main says never squash while linked playbooks prefer squash; councils require a red-team Markdown output while core-red-team mandates JSONL only; host-parity uses tracked roster while declared-vs-actual insists filesystem discovery is authoritative. These are active sibling contracts, not merely two unexecuted historical examples.
findings.recommended_action: Select one current contract per boundary and fence earlier variants as history, with explicit compatibility/version mappings instead of contradictory mandatory rules.
findings.validation: Full source-body review; no retained program or historical command executed.

findings.title: Pedagogy exactness and proof tags need narrower mathematical carriers
findings.finding: Scaffolding requires all cochain/eigenvalue calculations use Fraction, but rational matrices can have irrational eigenvalues, e.g. [[0,2],[1,0]] has roots of lambda^2-2. The claim legend also overloads Proved between kernel proof and finite Python execution, while another reference mandates a different eight-tag taxonomy.
findings.recommended_action: Permit exact algebraic/symbolic carriers where rationals are not closed under the operation; distinguish Formal, finite Executed/Tested and Declared without overloading Proved.
findings.validation: Full source-body review; no retained program or historical command executed.

findings.title: Retractions, transposes and complementary projectors are not involutions
findings.finding: The active-obstruction reference correctly distinguishes r composed u=id from involution, then names u/r, d0/d0-transpose and complementary projectors dual involution pairs. Retractions may be differently typed; projectors satisfy P squared=P, not identity, and a transpose is not a map inverse.
findings.recommended_action: Use section/retraction, transpose or complementary-projector terminology with declared domains. Reserve involution for an endomorphism whose square is identity.
findings.validation: Full source review and stated mathematical reasoning; no retained workflow executed.

findings.title: Regular degree alone does not imply Kesten--McKay spectral universality
findings.finding: The anti-skill reference requires the Kesten--McKay law for fixed-d regular graphs without random-ensemble or local-tree convergence assumptions. Disjoint unions of K4 are 3-regular of increasing size with unchanged atomic spectral masses 1/4 at 3 and 3/4 at -1.
findings.recommended_action: State a random regular or locally tree-like limit theorem with its hypotheses and distinguish finite empirical spectra from an asymptotic distribution.
findings.validation: CHECK-041 gives exact eigenvectors/eigenvalues and the disjoint-union sequence.

findings.title: Suggested modular normalization can overflow the stated native integer carrier
findings.finding: The formula ((lhs % m)+m)%m is mathematically valid for positive m but the addition can exceed a fixed signed integer range even when lhs and m are valid. For i64, m=MAX and lhs=MAX-1 gives intermediate 2*MAX-1.
findings.recommended_action: Use a checked/widened remainder operation or conditional addition only when the remainder is negative; reject zero modulus and document signed MIN/-1 behavior.
findings.validation: CHECK-040 uses exact integers; no native execution.

findings.title: Strict quotient improvement by an exact gauge CUT is impossible
findings.finding: Phi(c)=min_phi ||c-dphi||1 is invariant under c -> c-dpsi by translating phi. The reference nevertheless admits CUT exactly when Phi(c-dpsi)<Phi(c), so it rejects every genuine pure-gauge CUT. Reducing a representative norm or changing admitted cochains is a different operation and needs its own protected-query contract.
findings.recommended_action: Separate representative residual improvement from quotient obstruction. Use gauge invariance as a check; for obstruction reduction declare and verify a changed problem/carrier with lawful transport.
findings.validation: CHECK-037 proves equality on a triangle; the change-of-variable argument applies generally.

findings.title: Nonpositive change is mislabeled strict descent
findings.finding: The manifold reference labels Delta <=0 as Strict Descent, admitting stationary steps indefinitely. Strict rational decrease also needs a finite fuel or well-founded positive granularity for termination; the main WDP guide correctly adds fuel.
findings.recommended_action: Use <0 for strict improvement and a separate nonincrease condition; state bounded fuel/termination premise rather than infer it from the label.
findings.validation: CHECK-042 demonstrates a stationary accepted step.

findings.title: PFP strict-type and budget checks only test local examples and contain invalid-input acceptance
findings.finding: The PFP script cannot reject bool via isinstance(val,bool) and not isinstance(val,int), since Python bool is an int subclass. Missing/null/string answers also pass. Its mock ledger treats every non-None cost as valid, allowing negative, nonfinite and excessive charges; tests only exercise None. Hardcoded safe prompt and self-produced digests do not audit real prompt assembly or receipt replay.
findings.recommended_action: Use exact integer type plus complete candidate shape and domain validation, exact bounded nonnegative monetary fields, and production-owner tests with bound external problem/receipt inputs. Rename remaining examples as illustrations.
findings.validation: CHECK-039 and CHECK-043 mirror exact branches on synthetic inputs; no production or retained checker execution.

findings.title: Dual feasibility alone is mislabeled a complete optimality certificate
findings.finding: The simplicial reference lists d-transpose w=0 and infinity norm <=1 as the certificate for Phi. Those only establish feasibility/lower bounds. The zero vector always satisfies them, including a triangle with primal optimum one and dual value zero.
findings.recommended_action: Require primal feasibility and objective equality with the paired dual witness, including declared weights and exact arithmetic. Reuse the fuller solver-reference contract.
findings.validation: CHECK-038 gives a feasible zero dual with a positive gap.

findings.title: Live Genesis and S(n) reference tables disagree on the native frontier
findings.finding: One live reference says native S0--S6 and graph-free core; another assigns 22 native levels including simplex, Hodge and Regge content, and another uses a different 00--21 sealed Genesis table. These can be separate presentations/editions but the files do not bind a common translation and caller-specific frontier.
findings.recommended_action: Pin each table to an owner, carrier and edition and record explicit correspondence/noncorrespondence. Do not aggregate stage labels as additional native mathematical capacity.
findings.validation: Full source review and stated mathematical reasoning; no retained workflow executed.

findings.title: Pipeline and runtime verification success exceeds the actual predicates
findings.finding: Pipeline linter checks two files for tolerance/Fraction substrings and only warns about a potential probe defect. ROP checker accepts any nonempty two files. Neither verifies producer hashes, candidate bijection, monad laws, exceptions, atomic ledgers or probe firewall, yet terminals say invariants hold/firewall verified.
findings.recommended_action: Report exact structural/lexical checks, classify semantic obligations unavailable, and use pinned executable owner controls for each promised property.
findings.validation: Complete branch review establishes absence of the advertised checks.

findings.title: Test-isolation guidance and checker leave concurrency and population gaps
findings.finding: A shared --basetemp path can collide across concurrent pytest runs. The checker only creates scratch, omits nested engine/tests Python files and lacks the advertised POSIX absolute-path patterns; it never validates actual basetemp use or interpreter/isolation. The loadfile scheduling advice does not eliminate per-worker collection.

findings.title: WDP checks cannot establish their displayed semantic invariants
findings.finding: CODA zero-gap check assigns both sides one without any feasible witnesses, and type separation assigns residual and defect the same Fraction. DDC code membership accepts an arbitrary substring/comment. Prime checks two counts of nine without comparing conjunct identities or evaluating any continuation predicate. The main skill correctly disclaims Rust/Lean replay, but scripts retain stronger success labels.

findings.title: Lean audit source scans are not AST inspection or complete theorem adequacy
findings.finding: The skill labels two rg scans as AST inspection. These can match comments, miss qualified/alternative declarations and cannot identify all transitive dependencies. The subsequent #print axioms is useful, but a standard axiom list alone does not verify the intended statement or rule out an explicit False premise.

findings.title: Education frontmatter examples conflict with their own schema
findings.finding: Template supplies uppercase SSS despite lowercase-only tag pattern; file-type variations omit globally required section. Invalid-example title is below the claimed 255-character limit. Validation snippet lacks import json and leaves frontmatter unset without a delimiter. Numerous code fences are damaged by inserted heading prefixes/ext suffixes.

findings.title: Pedagogy corrections introduce unqualified mathematical claims
findings.finding: An example correction says an eigenstate changes on measurement, although an ideal projective measurement of its own observable leaves it unchanged. A domain-expert sample asks for Hom(-,H) to preserve adjoint structure without specifying category, contravariance or a codomain dagger. SSS examples also require fixed-length Euclidean frameworks modulo rigid motions, not literal object identity or all physical rigidity.
findings.recommended_action: State admitted model, observable/instrument, category/maps and rigidity equivalence before teaching a conclusion. Keep physical analogy separate from formal theorem and empirical evidence.
findings.validation: CHECK-046 gives an exact two-dimensional projective counterexample; other limits follow type/domain review.

findings.title: Core education and verification wrappers have mostly empty operative sections
findings.finding: Human-promotion firewall, integration-audit, education engine, scientific-hypothesis tree and verification-loop packages retain descriptions and empty headings without the promised schemas, failure protocols or implementations. These should not count as executable workflow/detector capacity merely because registered.

findings.title: Generated metaskill leaves contradict the shared residual-evidence boundary
findings.finding: The shared verifier correctly says finite residual observations remain diagnostics regardless of count and general contraction needs a checked statement. Every generated leaf instead permits admission after three observed contractive runs. A before/after scalar drop is also not a metric contraction theorem, and zero-to-zero preservation need not be strict contraction.
findings.recommended_action: Make leaves defer to the shared finite-evidence ceiling, name the exact diagnostic and admitted domain, and remove unsupported contractive frontmatter. Prove any general preservation/decrease statement separately.

findings.title: Historical meta traces omit the inputs required by their declared signatures
findings.finding: Three retained traces claim unary State, Receipt or Paper transformations but record inputs=[]. Each binds only an output path/hash and residual numbers, with no actual input/problem/producer/metric pin. findings.title: Comment-purge helper can corrupt source and cross the advertised preservation boundary
findings.finding: The C/Rust block regex deletes comment-like substrings inside strings and merges adjacent tokens, while Python comment removal also strips meaningful shebang/encoding/type/licence directives. Test protection checks basename only, so files under tests may be rewritten. Recursive writes follow file symlinks and lack a root containment/custody transaction. Shared verifier promises preserved licence notices and tests.

findings.title: Meta launchers can bind to an unrelated current working checkout
findings.finding: Every launcher accepts Path.cwd() with .git and .agents before its own ancestors, then prepends that root to sys.path and imports a shared CLI. Executing the retained script from another qualifying checkout can import a different implementation without pinning it.
findings.recommended_action: Anchor implementation discovery to the script/package or explicit verified repo root and record exact imported producer path/hash; do not let incidental CWD choose semantics.
findings.validation: Full source-body assessment; no retained workflow executed.

findings.title: Skew-information inequality fails for the stated arbitrary CPTP channel
findings.finding: Source defines I_rho(H)=Tr(rho H²)-Tr(sqrt(rho)Hsqrt(rho)H) and claims I_E(rho)(E(H))<=I_rho(H). Take rho=diag(1/3,2/3), H=P0, E(A)=A00 P0+A11 Pplus. Kraus K0=|0><0| and K1=|+><1| sum KdaggerK=I. E(H)=H, but E(rho)=[[2/3,1/3],[1/3,1/3]], so I grows from0 to1/15. Both states are positive definite. This is not the correctly transported tangent-vector monotonicity theorem.
findings.recommended_action: Remove or restrict this inequality with exact channel/observable hypotheses and proof; separate skew information from general monotone metric contraction. Retain this negative control.
findings.validation: CHECK-050 verifies complete channel/state/observable, positive square root identity and rational terms2/3-3/5=1/15.

findings.title: Closed overlap differences are incorrectly called pairwise agreement
findings.finding: Reference first defines omega=delta0(local observations), then calls delta1 omega=0 pairwise consistency. For local values0,1,2 on a triangle, edge differences1,1,-2 are nonzero but sum0. Such omega is already exact by definition; its closed-survivor branch cannot occur without changing the supplied data model. Nilpotence, closedness, exactness and agreement are distinct predicates.
findings.recommended_action: Define independent edge data when closed nonexact classes are intended; test delta0(local)=0 for agreement. Require image/kernel equality for exactness, not only d²=0. The skill phrase exact complexes with d²=0 may impose both, so do not treat its wording alone as a proved false implication.
findings.validation: CHECK-051/052 separate nilpotence from exactness and closedness from zero differences.

findings.title: Nonzero H1 group is not equivalent to missing global sections
findings.finding: Source asserts no global sections iff H1 is nonzero, including a Set-valued presheaf without an abelianization/support construction. Constant Q coefficients on a circle have H1=Q and many global constant sections. A particular contextuality obstruction class, empirical support and the whole cohomology group must not be identified.
findings.recommended_action: Specify empirical model, support/distribution extension problem, coefficient construction and distinguished obstruction class; state only the direction and completeness theorem actually justified.
findings.validation: CHECK-053 supplies explicit incidence matrix, rank2, H1 dimension1 and global zero section.

findings.title: Discrete Wigner expression lacks normalization and characteristic restriction
findings.finding: With the displayed phase-point convention, Tr A=1 and maximally mixed rho=I/d gives the displayed W=1/d at d² points, summing to d. Standard normalized W needs an additional1/d. The exponent also uses inverse2 for every prime d, which is undefined in characteristic2.
findings.recommended_action: State odd-prime/odd-prime-power domain and consistent displacement/phase-point/Wigner conventions; test total mass and marginals before using contextuality conclusions.
findings.validation: CHECK-057 computes the d=3 maximally mixed normalization failure.

findings.title: General-poset and cross-domain obstruction formulas omit required structure
findings.finding: Galois connections yield an upper closure operator, but subtraction c-gamma(alpha(c)) is undefined for general posets. Truncation A->||A||n is a unit map, not generally an inclusion. Displayed lifting problem also asks a map X->E to extend f:A->B without specifying a lift on A or base extension on X.
findings.recommended_action: Keep the valid order closure statement; admit extra additive/metric structure before a numerical residual. Repair types and local-coefficient/simplicity hypotheses before claiming universal obstruction unification.
findings.validation: Full source body reviewed; no retained workflow executed.

findings.title: SUSY note promotes determinant equality and superalgebra into missing guarantees
findings.finding: Equality det J=det DF does not force a positive determinant; superalgebra {Q,Qdagger}=2H alone does not force every state to be annihilated by Q. A zero-energy state premise would be needed. The note supplies no boundary-map bridge from this algebra to simplicial nilpotence and lists3D Pachner counts under a4D heading.
findings.recommended_action: Require explicit admitted complexes, determinant sign/domain conditions, zero-energy constraint and chain-map proof; use dimension-correct moves and treat sampled positivity as finite evidence.
findings.validation: CHECK-054/055/056 provide negative determinant, two-state supercharge and facet-count controls.

findings.title: Schema conformer upgrades evidence labels and drops valid quoted aliases
findings.finding: The mechanical MANUAL->VERIFIED migration map claims test/source verification without running or binding any verification. Alias regex recognizes double quoting only, so a valid single-quoted gt alias is dropped. Delimiter scanning can treat a later Markdown horizontal rule as frontmatter.

findings.title: Quantum/gauge unification confuses conditional, geometric and dynamical claims
findings.finding: Nonzero curvature need not give nonidentity holonomy on every chosen loop (an abelian flux2pi is a counterexample). One amplitude vector sqrt(probability) exp(i phase) does not encode every mixed density operator. P rho P is unnormalized postselection unless divided by its probability. Failure of a time-homogeneous semigroup does not alone prove non-Markovian memory; a time-dependent unitary propagator can be CP-divisible.
findings.recommended_action: Name the admitted bundle/local trivialization, loop, instrument and conditioning convention; distinguish pure-state encoding, mixed states, homogeneous semigroups and CP-divisibility. Supply actual cochain maps rather than assigning C1 by label.

findings.finding: If an inline list contains any quote, parser extracts quoted values only and drops unquoted items; duplicate keys overwrite without an error. The target manifest is also read unconditionally after same-source lookup. Printed parity-gate language is not an executable proof or verification check.

findings.finding: Frozen dataclasses already generate exact-class equality; absence of explicit __eq__ is not cross-type vulnerability. Scanner instead accepts a guard substring anywhere in unparsed source, including a docstring, without checking control flow. Dotted decorators and missing target populations are also omitted.

findings.finding: Isolation helper only ensures CWD/scratch exists, creating it if missing. Architecture discovery only includes engine* and the_symbol_game roots, excluding pfp, and never comprehensively checks inward imports. Filename/class heuristics, adapter exemptions and ignored syntax errors can pass unchecked behavior.

findings.finding: Zero d0/d1 does not force Phi1 zero: distance of omega=1 from image(d0)={0} is1. Valid exact repair on a graph needs no2-faces. findings.title: TDVP follow-on recipe omits subgradient and tangent transport conditions
findings.finding: The full displayed dual certificate has norm bound, saturation and tangent annihilation and is useful. However sign(Q)+P_Tperp(V) with only a norm check need not saturate Q. Contractivity of a channel alone does not imply distance to a fixed tangent is nonincreasing; a Hadamard channel sends Z in span(Z) to X outside it.

findings.title: Normal-form CDC repair omits deterministic ties and projected dependencies
findings.finding: ROW_NUMBER ordering only by event_timestamp and sequence_num leaves two same-key events with different payloads unordered. The recursive BCNF sketch also needs the implied FD projection on each component, not merely original FDs whose attributes happen to fit.
